title: One nonce, two signatures, no secret: ECDSA nonce reuse
summary: In 2010 Sony signed PlayStation 3 updates with the same ECDSA nonce every time, and the private signing key fell out with high-school algebra mod n. We do the same algebra on small numbers.

case.name: PlayStation 3 ECDSA key recovery (fail0verflow)
case.impact: Sony's console code-signing private key recovered; anyone could sign software the PS3 would trust
